method: Built-in image generation using salon and Ruby as style references, followed by transparent cutout cleanup for chair and lamp. Artwork is scaled within the existing salon SVG.

chair.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent-background sprite for Lucy's Luxury Nails game. The supplied salon background and girl are STYLE references only. Match their polished softly shaded dimensional cartoon illustration: delicate warm outlines, painted gradients, subtle material texture and soft daylight, pastel pink lavender blue palette. Camera is straight on with a very slight view down onto surfaces, for a furniture item standing on the pictured salon floor. Isolated complete single object centered with generous transparent margin on every side. NO room, walls, floor plane, background color, people, lettering, logos, watermark, or other objects. Preserve true transparency. Avoid flat vector/icon appearance, photorealism, harsh black outlines, plastic 3D render appearance. One elegant simple ivory upholstered manicure chair, rounded rectangular softly padded backrest and seat, delicate stitched edge, four slender brushed-silver legs. Armless, no wheels. Neutral ivory fabric so the game can tint the upholstery pink or blue. Chair faces the camera squarely; small amount of seat top visible. Entire four legs and backrest included.
